# Steady 2.21.11

## What's new
- **Day off opens the web** — sunny day off keeps inappropriate sites blocked (adult / gambling / dating / malware) but no longer locks normal browsing behind the age filter.
- **Always-allow covers all subdomains** — approving `www.news.com` allows `amp.news.com` and every other subdomain automatically.
- **Steady sites stay allowed** — `labratkali.github.io` and `*.less-phone.workers.dev` (including study/steady) are on the allow list.

## For parents
Take a day off again after updating if the VPN still felt locked from an earlier session.
